signatures.name: above_chance_discrimination
signatures.description: Hit rate is significantly higher than false-alarm rate (paired comparison). The headline signature of recognition memory: agents say 'old' more often to actually-old items than to new items.

signatures.name: above_chance_accuracy
signatures.description: Overall accuracy is significantly above 0.5 (chance) on the test trials.

signatures.name: low_false_alarm_rate
signatures.description: False-alarm rate (saying OLD to truly NEW items) is significantly below 0.5 — the agent is not just saying OLD to everything.
